answer.reason: The verses tell what was made, what happened through the bronze serpent, and how it was later destroyed.

clauses.english: was made by Moses and set on a pole, and everyone bitten by serpents who looked on it lived
clauses.quote: when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived

clauses.english: was broken in pieces by Hezekiah because the people burned incense to it, and he called it Nehushtan
clauses.quote: brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made

doubts: JHN 3:14 compares Moses lifting up the serpent to the Son of man being lifted up; left out as interpretation.
